title: An import update onto COD saves a $0 limit and the row is not refused
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • Scenario: You re-import a Net 30 customer with an $800 limit to put it on COD.
  • You are an Admin user working at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Customer {Customer-A} exists on Net 30 with a credit limit of $800.00.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S10-07 Customer.
  • A contacts import file that updates {Customer-A} with the credit term "COD" and the credit limit 800.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Import the file through Settings, Data Import, Contacts.
  2. Open Edit Customer for {Customer-A}.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the import finishes; no row is refused because of its credit term.
  • Step 2: Credit Terms reads COD and Credit Limit shows $0.00, disabled.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11679 (Story 10, Imports and Public API)

  • S10-R8: “A customer created or updated through the Public API, or updated by the contacts import, onto COD or Credit Hold is saved with a $0 credit limit, whatever limit was sent; the request or row is not refused (S10-N1). A Public API update that sends neither a credit term nor a credit limit leaves the stored limit as it is.”
  • S10-N1: “Imports and the Public API never refuse a row or a request because of its credit term.”
